sentences.text:
Kohinoor Begam @ Kohinoor Begum vs The State Of West
Bengal & Anr on 1 October, 2024
01.10.2024 Sl. No.58 Sws.M Crr 2793 of 2024 Kohinoor Begam @ Kohinoor Begum Vs. The State
of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Sabyasachi Mukherjee Mr. Noortaz Ahmed Mallick Mr. P. Dey Mr. Mukesh Khanna Md. Musa
Desai Mr. Kiran Mallick ....for the petitioner Learned advocate for the petitioner is present.

Heard
learned advocate for the petitioner.

The petitioner in the instant case has sought for quashing of GR Case No. 5465 of 2023 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purba Bardhaman arising out of Sadar P.S. Case No. 464 of 2023 dated 28.09.2023 under Sections 498A/406/120B/34 of the IPC.
Learned advocate for the petitioner submits that the case against his client is not maintainable as the complainant's/husband is not implicated in this case.
Learned advocate relies upon the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Kailashben Mahendrabhai Patel & Ors. vs. State of Maharashtra & Anr. in Criminal Appeal No. 4003 of 2024.

entities.text: Kailashben Mahendrabhai Patel & Ors. vs. State of Maharashtra & Anr. in Criminal Appeal No. 4003 of 2024
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned advocate submits that his client is implicated as one of the family member of the petitioner executed in deed in favour of another person and not in favour of the complainant or her husband.
It is contended that the story of the allegations of the FIR is not only false but fabricated.

Upon hearing the learned advocate for the petitioner and considering the judicial decision relied upon and the materials on record, this Court is of the view that this revisional application should be admitted.
Thus, I admit this revisional application.
Let notice be issued upon the opposite parties and affidavit of service be filed within one week on the reopening date after vacation.
Let the matter appear as 'Contested Application' after three weeks from the date of reopening after vacation.

Pending hearing of this application, there shall be a stay of further proceedings in connection with GR Case No. 5465 of 2023 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purba Bardhaman for a period of five weeks of reopening after vacation.
